headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.28
summary: This release fixes the icon-only side rails on phones with a camera cutout on the rail's side: the column dodges sideways by a few dp instead of being pushed down the screen, and the icons center exactly in the remaining space.

items.text: Fixed the icon-only left and right navigation rails on cutout devices: the previous below-the-cutout padding pushed the whole column to the middle of the screen when the camera sits mid-edge (the usual waterdrop in landscape). The rail now dodges sideways just enough to clear the camera at any hole position, and the icons center exactly in the remaining width instead of clamping against their paddings.
